projects.title: Book Finder
projects.description:
Book Finder is a simple web application that uses the Open Library API. The app allows users to search for a book by title, and sort and filter the results. Additional information about each book can be found by clicking on the corresponding book in the list. 
This application was created with HTML, CSS, React, Redux, and Express, and was deployed to Heroku.

The code for this project can be found here: https://github.com/GooMiHo/mr-app-library-challenge

projects.title: Let it Brie
projects.description:
Let is Brie is our version of the Grace Shopper project, assigned to us by Grace Hopper. We were tasked with creating an e-commerce site over the course of a week using Javascript, React, Redux, Sequelize, OAuth, and Stripe. 

The code for this project can be found here: https://github.com/GooMiHo/let-it-brie
